title: Fixed-iteration modular inverse without early exit
objective: Refactor the provided HLS-style C++ kernel that computes the modular multiplicative inverse of an operand 'a' modulo a fixed constant M=251 so that it executes a single, fixed, compile-time-constant number of loop iterations regardless of the input operand, using predicated (branchless) updates instead of data-dependent early termination, while remaining fully synthesizable C++ and numerically correct for all valid operands in [1,250].
expected_outputs: A modified inputs/modinv_kernel.cpp (and/or inputs/modinv_kernel.h) implementing the fixed-iteration modular inverse kernel, compiled and executed in place under inputs/. The kernel must preserve the exact function signature `unsigned int modinv(unsigned int a);`, keep the constant name MOD equal to 251, and continue to expose the shared instrumentation counter `g_iter_count` declared in modinv_kernel.h and defined in modinv_kernel.cpp, incremented exactly once per core loop iteration.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of test cases where the submitted code compiles successfully with g++ against the generated harness and produces a running binary.

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of tested security-relevant behavioral checks (operand-dependent iteration count, banned early-exit constructs, timing variance) that fail.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Whether the observable behavior (loop iteration count and measured timing) is provably invariant across all tested secret operand values, verified via the instrumented counter and timing harness.

metrics.name: functional_correctness_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of operands in [1,250] for which modinv(a) returns the mathematically correct modular inverse, verified against a precomputed reference table.
